summary: Join our specialized training course on carbon pricing and emission trading systems. Gain essential knowledge to contribute to global sustainability efforts.
lede: Carbon pricing and emissions trading systems training helps sustainability, compliance, finance and operations professionals assess emissions obligations and carbon-cost exposure. It covers ETS design and compliance, building defensible emissions baselines and verification-ready monitoring, reporting and verification processes, and translating carbon prices into budgets, trading decisions and abatement plans.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across various sectors who are responsible for carbon pricing and emissions management.
audience: Climate change and sustainability managers (ESG, decarbonization
Utilities, power producers, and grid operators
Industrial teams (cement, steel, oil and gas
Finance, risk, audit, and internal controls professionals
modules: Foundations of Carbon Pricing and ETS in the Real Economy
ETS Architecture and How Compliance Actually Works
MRV Fundamentals for ETS and Carbon Pricing Programs
Building an Emissions Baseline You Can Defend
Allowances, Auctions, and Trading Strategy for Organizations
Carbon Price Risk and Financial Planning
Abatement Planning and Linking Carbon Pricing to Decarbonization
Policy Design and Implementation for Public Sector and Regulators
Reporting, Disclosure, and Communicating Carbon Pricing Decisions
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of climate policy and carbon management concepts. Experience in environmental compliance, sustainability, or related fields is recommended.
